title: Concept: Python requirement with an open lower bound
description: requirements.txt declares a `>=` requirement with no upper bound, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every future major release satisfies the line, so an incompatible or compromised release installs on the next build.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: Every future major release satisfies the line, so an incompatible or compromised release installs on the next build.
